newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Euromoney forecasts that Lithuania's GDP will grow by 3.74 percent in 1997 and by 4.04 percent next year.

- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landbergis says that Russian politicians are saying bad things about Lithuania in an effort to provoke Lithuania to respond in kind. Landsbergis says that this will create an image in the West that there are tensions between the two states.
